invariant: Return destinations and parallel message identity belong to command-event history, independent of accepted drawable life variations. A message cannot reactivate a participant after its own close/destroy. Return color is validated by HColorSet before the message is added.
causal_divergence: Rust loses & identity; it resolves returns from a stack popped only on accepted painted closes. A destroyed participant can prevent a return pop and duplicate the next return. Parser permits forbidden same-message transitions and arbitrary return color names.
planned_change: Retain parallel flags; resolve return messages from shared source-history logic before geometry, preserving stack ownership through destroy and group END. Validate transitions per owning message and validate the CommandReturn color grammar using the pinned color-name domain. Keep parser error status separate from valid SVG parity.
